question: For one predeclared engineering role and pool, can at most three recorded answers of at most ten minutes each select later strong performers at a specified capacity as well as a longer pipeline and better than an equal-time comparator?
inclusions: First-session creative reasoning through unusual problems
exclusions: Selection validity inferred only from public challenge scores

selection_criteria: Record role, population, outcome, method and uncertainty
Separate vendor-reported claims from independent results
source_policy.conflict_handling: Keep competing findings and identify population or method differences before synthesis.
source_policy.freshness_rule: Recheck mutable legal, product and market sources at the relevant decision time.

stop_conditions: Held-out study reaches its preregistered stopping rule
limitations: Current literature scan is not systematic
claim_ceiling: Candidate inquiry and source plan only; no empirical conclusion or data-collection permission.
